scene.label: mAbV, step by step
scene.title: From a founder's sketch to a sign on the door.

steps.title: The brief
steps.note: A young company that had said little in public yet, working with Oxford University. It came with a working name, a domain and a paragraph of science, and needed an identity investors and scientists could trust.

stage.caption: Every letter is intentional. The casing makes the acronym readable inside the word.

steps.title: The idea
steps.note: An antibody is shaped like a Y, and the mark is built from one. The shield around it frames what the company works on: protection before infection.

callouts.text: Four bars: the antibody's two arms form the V
A teardrop stem forms the point

steps.title: The exploration
steps.note: I developed the mark from the founder's first sketch into the final system, testing it against ten other routes at three sizes and on navy.

stage.caption: Five of the eleven routes, converging on the final mark.

steps.title: One blue
steps.note: Teal is the category's default, and the first draft's teal sat close to a familiar financial brand. I moved mAbV to one cobalt, tied to Pantone 2728 C so print matches screen.

steps.title: Two scripts
steps.note: In China the company trades as {{cn:百卫信}}, set in Noto Sans SC Bold to match the DM Sans wordmark, and outlined so it looks the same on any device.

art.alt: Bilingual mAbV lockup with 百卫信

stage.note: DM Sans Bold for Latin · Noto Sans SC Bold for Chinese

photo.alt: Reception sign in Guangzhou: the lockup above the company's registered name

steps.title: The system
steps.note: Eight sections, live at mabvbio.com. The rules are shown, not just stated: below 32 px the mark switches to a simple V.

stage.alt: The logo page of the live mAbV design system

steps.title: The kit
steps.note: Eighteen files in SVG, PNG, PDF and EPS, outlined type, the Pantone instruction for printers, and a readme in English and Chinese.

stage.alt: Brand Kit page of the mAbV design system

steps.title: In the world
steps.note: The identity on the company's doors in Guangzhou: a reception sign and frosted film on the glass. A real installation, not a mockup.

photos.alt: The mAbV lockup on a frosted glass door
The lockup repeated along the frosted glass wall of the reception
